summary: Passed focused independent closure: whitespace-only titles now receive a visible fallback while nonempty raw strings remain exact; incomplete valid dueAt deadlines use elapsed instant comparison independent of display timezone, date-only dueOn becomes overdue only after its local civil day, and completed tasks stay excluded. Both previously reported defects are resolved on the before/after verified 90-file source pin. No additional actionable security or logic defect was found in the scoped fixes; 14 actual-source focused tests, both typechecks and 42 independent boundary assertions passed. Catalog-only assessment, not live or promotion approval.
